001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Collections;
005import java.util.HashSet;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Set;
008import org.clafer.common.Check;
009import org.clafer.common.UnsatisfiableException;
010
011/**
012 * The compiled model in IR. A module contains variables and constraints. The IR
013 * is permitted to throw away any variables during the optimization.
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class IrModule {
018
019    private final List<IrBoolExpr> constraints;
020
021    public IrModule() {
022        this(100);
023    }
024
025    public IrModule(int initialConstraintCapacity) {
026        this.constraints = new ArrayList<>(initialConstraintCapacity);
027    }
028
029    public IrModule addVariable(IrVar var) {
030        if (!var.isConstant()) {
031            constraints.add(new IrRegister(var));
032        }
033        return this;
034    }
035
036    public IrModule addVariables(IrVar... vars) {
037        for (IrVar var : vars) {
038            addVariable(var);
039        }
040        return this;
041    }
042
043    public IrModule addVariables(Iterable<? extends IrVar> vars) {
044        for (IrVar var : vars) {
045            addVariable(var);
046        }
047        return this;
048    }
049
050    public Set<IrVar> getVariables() {
051        Set<IrVar> variables = new HashSet<>();
052        for (IrBoolExpr constraint : constraints) {
053            variables.addAll(IrUtil.getVariables(constraint));
054        }
055        return variables;
056    }
057
058    public IrModule addConstraint(IrBoolExpr expr) {
059        Check.notNull(expr);
060        if (expr instanceof IrAnd) {
061            IrAnd and = (IrAnd) expr;
062            for (IrBoolExpr operand : and.getOperands()) {
063                addConstraint(operand);
064            }
065        } else if (expr.getDomain().isFalse()) {
066            throw new UnsatisfiableException();
067        } else if (!expr.getDomain().isTrue()) {
068            constraints.add(expr);
069        }
070        return this;
071    }
072
073    public IrModule addConstraints(IrBoolExpr... exprs) {
074        for (IrBoolExpr expr : exprs) {
075            addConstraint(expr);
076        }
077        return this;
078    }
079
080    public IrModule addConstraints(Iterable<? extends IrBoolExpr> exprs) {
081        for (IrBoolExpr expr : exprs) {
082            addConstraint(expr);
083        }
084        return this;
085    }
086
087    public List<IrBoolExpr> getConstraints() {
088        return Collections.unmodifiableList(constraints);
089    }
090
091    @Override
092    public String toString() {
093        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
094        result.append("IrModule").append('\n');
095        for (IrBoolExpr constraint : constraints) {
096            result.append("--").append(constraint).append('\n');
097        }
098        return result.toString();
099    }
100}
